name: Kumatsu Gyobu
source:
A wandering curse-slinger and martial artist hired by the Futatsuguri family.
Despite being nearly 60, Gyobu's well-honed physique belies his age.
When it comes to jujutsu, he surpasses both Fuminari Shuuzou and Togetsu Kan.

"In this world, there exist things more terrifying than death itself."
